mapper.sql: id, user_id, account_id, symbol, name, market_country, currency, quantity, average_purchase_price, last_price, purchase_amount, market_value, profit_loss_amount, profit_loss_rate
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tbl_investment_holding WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM tbl_investment_holding WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT ih.id, ih.user_id, ih.account_id, ih.symbol, ih.name, ih.market_country, ih.currency, ih.quantity, ih.average_purchase_price, ih.last_price, ih.purchase_amount, ih.market_value, ih.profit_loss_amount, ih.profit_loss_rate FROM tbl_investment_holding ih JOIN tbl_connected_account ca ON ca.id = ih.account_id WHERE ih.user_id = #{userId} AND ca.is_active = 1 ORDER BY ih.id
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_investment_holding SET name = #{name}, market_country = #{marketCountry}, currency = #{currency}, quantity = #{quantity}, average_purchase_price = #{averagePurchasePrice}, purchase_amount = #{purchaseAmount}, market_value = ROUND(last_price * #{quantity}, 4), profit_loss_amount = ROUND(last_price * #{quantity} - #{purchaseAmount}, 4), profit_loss_rate = CASE WHEN #{purchaseAmount} = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((last_price * #{quantity} - #{purchaseAmount}) / #{purchaseAmount}, 4) END WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND symbol = #{symbol}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_investment_holding (user_id, account_id, symbol, name, market_country, currency, quantity, average_purchase_price, last_price, purchase_amount, market_value, profit_loss_amount, profit_loss_rate) VALUES (#{userId}, #{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{name}, #{marketCountry}, #{currency}, #{quantity}, #{averagePurchasePrice}, #{lastPrice}, #{purchaseAmount}, #{marketValue}, #{profitLossAmount}, #{profitLossRate})
